root_clarification: Lack of a rigorous e_app is not a new mandatory blocker to a declared ordinary-double static test. Existing worker remains preserved and unbound.

recommended_contract.target: Same normalized relative stability threshold, epsilon=1e-6, for the exact saved coefficient/operator scope under ordinary-double numerical qualification.
required_numerical_checks: Matched saved geometry/cell/grid/boundary, active positive-alpha map, candidate H, upper-bound and initialization/source/runtime pins; finite bounds and positive U_nominal.
Actual stored q nonnegative/finite, declared stencil/adjoint domain, delta_odd derived from that same snapshot, and unchanged symmetry checks. No q clamping or symmetrization.

One fixed qualified factor attempt, positive accepted LL factor, no unsupported warning or backend failure, existing sparse factor-action and solve residual checks. Preserve boundary/inconclusive classifications.

Retain the declared native parity/application/residual probes and their exact finite scope as numerical implementation evidence. They are not a uniform full-box e_app estimate; no new probe execution is authorized by this source review.
recommended_contract.positive_result: passed_nominal_static_sufficient_numerical_test, limited to this saved operator and declared ordinary-double checks
recommended_contract.negative_or_missing_result: An unsuccessful sufficient real-split test is inconclusive for full PME stability; malformed/missing inputs and numerical/backend errors retain their distinct failures.
does_not_admit: interval or exact-arithmetic certificate from nominal bounds
recommended_contract.stronger_optional_contract: If a separately qualified allowance later exists, use U_star=U_B+U_R+e_app and tau=1e-6*U_star+delta_odd+e_app. This stronger contract is not a prerequisite to the nominal test.
